_comment: Revert receipts — the ONLY thing that makes a commit-ledger row `covered`. Each was produced by checking the commit out, confirming its package passed, restoring only its non-test files to the parent, and re-running the same tests until a NAMED test failed. `rejected` records candidates that did not prove: `disproved` means a test shipped beside a fix that does not notice the fix being undone, which is a finding rather than an absence.
